tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: List the operations available through the Descope Management bucket tools. Returns operation names grouped by bucket (access_control_read, access_control_write, ...).

tools.name: access_control_read
tools.description: Read-only FGA (fine-grained authorization) operations for the current Descope project. Dispatch by operation name. Operations: GetFGASchema (args: {}), DryRunSchema (args: {dsl: string}). Example: access_control_read({operation: "DryRunSchema", args: {dsl: "model AuthZ 1.0 ..."}}).

tools.name: access_control_write
tools.description: Write FGA (fine-grained authorization) operations for the current Descope project. Dispatch by operation name. Operations: CreateFGASchema (args: {dsl: string}). This is irreversible.
